messages:
elaine: Quick sync — I'm running a copy pass for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages and we need to lock the core headlines + key bullets before the benchmark webinar on Apr 8. Draft here: https://drive.redwood/example-copy-v2 :eyes:

mike: looked good at a glance. Can we make the Hosted headline more benefit-first? Right now it's feature-y.

tess: Agreed. Hosted should scream 'fastest time to value' — short phrase + 1 supporting line about predictable pricing.

samir: For Dedicated, let's lean into 'predictable throughput' and 'SLA-backed capacity' — customers care about throughput numbers. Maybe add an example: "> 1000 req/s with 99.9% uptime" as a callout.

olivia: Private page needs compliance-first language. Suggest: "Private deployment — full control, audit-ready" and mention KMS/HSM + VPC. Keep it simple.

ben: Design note — if we use a three-column comparison table, we should keep bullets to 6 or fewer per column. Also want icons for latency/cost/security.

elaine: Good recs. Proposed microheadlines (pick one): Hosted: "Get inference live in minutes" OR "Ship LLM features, fast". Dedicated: "Throughput you can commit to" OR "Reserved GPU capacity with SLAs". Private: "Customer-controlled inference" OR "Run in your VPC or on-prem". Thoughts?

mike: I like "Get inference live in minutes" for Hosted. It's concrete and tapers to our quick onboarding story.

tess: For Dedicated, "Reserved GPU capacity with SLAs" is clearer to procurement teams.

samir: +1 to that. For the Private one, prefer "Run in your VPC or on-prem" — customers search those phrases.

kate: Quick FYI on inbound routing: if someone selects 'Private' on the pricing form, route to SE + Solutions playbook owner. For Dedicated, route to AE + capacity planner. Hosted -> product demo flow. Can we add hidden form tag?

olivia: I'll update the routing rules in HubSpot. Kate, which form fields do you need?

kate: Need a single select field named "deployment_interest" with values: Hosted, Dedicated, Private. Also a free-text "expected_qps" optional field. That will help prioritize.

elaine: Copy-bot, run a quick readability check on the proposed headlines and bullets.

copy-bot: Readability check complete — headlines fall in the 9th–11th grade range. Suggest shortening bullets on Dedicated to reduce complexity.

ben: On the page layout — hero CTA for Hosted should be "Try Hosted API" and for Dedicated/Private variants we can use "Get capacity options" / "Request private deployment" respectively as sub-CTAs.

mike: Webinar tie-in: in the hero or feature area add a small ribbon: "Live webinar Apr 8: Latency vs Cost tradeoffs — register" with a link. That will boost signups and feed SQLs.

tess: We need a single benchmark callout for the webinar page: pick one clear stat that ties to Hosted vs Dedicated. Maybe: "Hosted: median latency 120ms (gns model), Dedicated: 45ms at steady load" — Samir can verify.

samir: I'll run the numbers today and post the exact bench stat. Don't commit to values on page until I confirm.

elaine: Action items: 1) Mike & Tess pick final microheadlines by EOD. 2) Samir to confirm benchmark numbers by tomorrow. 3) Ben to wireframe hero variants. 4) Kate & Olivia to add routing field to HubSpot. 5) I'll bake webinar ribbon into the page copy and prep email CTA.

olivia: noted, will add the field and set routing.

mike: ping me if you want a 10-min catch to choose the hero copy.

elaine: thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll update the doc with the chosen lines and re-post a clean snapshot for approvals.
